item.title: Water Quality, Perception and Knowledge in China
item.description: My thesis examined the relationship between perceived and actual (poor) water quality. I wrote my thesis in the Markdown editor Zettlr, defended (submitted) it in May 2021, and published it with Jupyter Book early in 2022. This post shares some of the process.

item.title: Two Percent for the Planet
